subject: Enable additional silos & contract addendum request
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Expansion request — 3 additional internal teams + renewal question

Hi Laura,

Quick note following our internal planning: we want to extend Redwood to three more internal teams (Customer Insights, Claims Automation, and Mobile Experience). High level ask below — can you confirm lead time and whether this requires a contract addendum or a minor amendment to our renewal terms?

- New projects: customer-insights, claims-automation, mobile-experience
- Estimated qps: 35 steady, peaks ~120 for Claims at end of month
- Need: separate API keys for each project + delegated key rotation policy
- Desired start for new teams: onboarding week of Dec 14, 2026

Additionally, our renewal is due Feb 1, 2027. Would prefer one consolidated addendum (capacity increase + 12-month term extension) instead of an immediate new contract.

Can you share a draft addendum and a ballpark for committed capacity pricing (reserved vs burst)? Happy to jump on a 30-min call this week.

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Reed
Director of Platform
Acme Health

Attachments: none in this message
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:34:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 additional internal teams + renewal question

Hi Taylor — thanks for the clear rundown.

Short answer: yes, we can support the three teams with dedicated API keys and a staged rollout. A single addendum that increases committed capacity and extends the term to align with your preference is the usual path. Next steps I propose:

1) We (Redwood) prepare a draft addendum adjusting committed units and term length.
2) You confirm the team owners and any data residency/permissions needs (we can keep everything under the same tenant).
3) We schedule a 30-min kickoff (aim for Dec 1–3) to align on rollout timeline, key distribution, and SSO/KMS requirements.

I've attached a first-pass draft addendum and a proposed rollout timeline for your review — both are editable. Monica from CS is looped in to scope onboarding tasks and any enablement sessions.

If the commitment materially increases (>=2x current), Marcus (copied to the thread) will propose pricing tiers (reserved vs burst-capacity) and options for a stepped ramp. 

Let me know if Dec 2 at 11am PT works for a quick sync.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acme_Addendum_v1.pdf (application/pdf), rollout_timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T08:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Expansion request — Acme Health (pricing + rollout planning)

Marcus / Rishi — forwarding Taylor's ask and the draft addendum. Highlights:
- 3 new internal projects, expected steady qps ~35 and peak ~120 for Claims
- Target onboarding week of Dec 14 (tight timeline)
- Wants single addendum that increases committed capacity and extends the term (renewal Feb 1, 2027)

Two pricing approaches to discuss before I respond to Acme:

Option A — conservative reserved commit:
- Add 50% committed tokens for first 12 months, steps to full commit by month 3
- Lower unit price, Redwood reserves capacity (SLA guarantee)
- Upside: predictable cost for Acme, clear commit for Redwood

Option B — hybrid burst + buffer:
- Moderate committed base + burst pool billed at overage rate (cushions peak events)
- Faster ramp, less initial commitment from customer

Operational asks: more API keys (3) to provision with labels, key rotation role mapping, and staging org for integration tests. Contract routing: legal prefers the addendum doc with tracked changes; Finance needs deal_id and revised ARR estimate to prepare PO language.

Can you propose a target pricing range for both options and a recommended internal timeline (provisioning, integration testing, enablement) by EOD Nov 26? I want to include specific numbers in my reply.

Thanks — Laura

Date: 2026-11-28T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — 3 additional internal teams + renewal question

Laura / team — thanks, that sounds good. Dec 2 at 11am PT works for a kickoff.

Quick confirmations so you can finalize the addendum:
- Team owners: Alex Murray (Customer Insights), Priya Singh (Claims Automation), Jenna Ortiz (Mobile Experience)
- Key governance: separate API keys per project, automated rotation monthly, read-only service principal for analytics team
- Residency: US-only data processing is preferred (no cross-region routing)
- Preferred term: extend by 12 months from Feb 1, 2027 (new end date Feb 1, 2028)

We're fine with a stepped ramp (Option B) as long as peak protection exists for Claims. Please include DocuSign-ready copy of the addendum. We'll have Legal sign once you send docusign.

Thanks — Taylor
Taylor Reed
Director of Platform
Acme Health
